profile.summary: CodeCombat is a company that makes educational games and courses that teach students to program in Python and JavaScript. Students learn by writing real code to progress through game levels. It also runs a related platform called Ozaria and started as an open-source community project.

review.notes: CodeCombat Inc. in San Francisco sells game-based Python/JavaScript coding curriculum, matching the agenda name, city and the classroom/academic services agreement. The About and Privacy pages confirm the legal name, address, headquarters, Ozaria mention and community-project origins; the summary is neutral.
